content.comment_body: I've been trying to connect my HMI to the [product_name] controller for several days, but so far there's no communication between them. The HMI appears to send signals correctly, yet the [product_name] does not respond. I've tested various configurations, including Modbus and Ethernet, multiple times. Is it possible that my [product_name] ([article_no]) does not support this HMI or its protocols? I followed a YouTube video ([url]) to set up Modbus, mirroring the steps shown. The HMI model is Kinco GL070E. If anyone has encountered this issue before, I'd appreciate advice on resolving it.

Your [product_name] is a version [version_no]. It supports Ethernet TCP/IP using the S7 protocol and Modbus TCP/IP. From what I know, you can connect the Kinco HMI via Ethernet TCP/IP, which tends to be simpler. Are you familiar with this document? [document] Search within it for '[product_name]' for related instructions.
